lineas.texto: You wake up around the year 1300, in a cart full of families, heading east into Pomerania.
A man rides ahead of you. He's the locator, hired by the duke to fill a brand-new town.
His promise: a plot of land, and several years without paying any rent.
For that, he gets the best plots and becomes the town's judge, and so will his sons.
The town doesn't grow by itself. It's drawn on the ground with ropes, in straight lines.
A big square in the middle for the market, and streets leaving from its corners.
Your first night, you sleep under the cart, on your own piece of land.
Part two, {when_next}: walls of earth, and a moat.
